meta.description: Hangs gill plates (lamellae) under a cap where a pattern has stripes: every stripe of reaction_diffusion becomes a plate that forks and starts between others where the stripes do. Gives every gill as thin paths stacked from the cap underside down to the gill edge, to mesh with the rest, and as a thin plate mesh, which stays sharp at any mesh resolution.

cap.description: The rays of a cap node, the gills hang from their underside and follow them when they move

hinge.description: The hinge of the cap node: where the cap sits and how thick the stipe is

pattern.description: Stripes around the axis, every stripe becomes a gill. Its radius is the distance along the cap underside from the axis.

depth.description: How far the gills reach down from the cap underside where they are deepest

depth_curve.label: Depth to the margin
depth_curve.description: How deep the gills are from the stipe (left) to the margin (right), as a share of the depth

free_distance.description: Gap between the gills and the stipe, Agaricus gills are free

edge_wave.description: How much the gill edges wave, sideways and up and down. 0 = straight edges, 1 = waves a third of the gill spacing wide
